shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json
cat src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep '"version"'; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; ls build/esm/components/theme; cat ../icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls tabs; cat tabs/index.d.ts; cat tabs/TabList/TabList.d.ts tabs/Tab/Tab.d.ts tabs/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; grep -o '\.g-root{[^}]*}' ../../../styles/styles.css | head; grep -o '\.g-root_theme_dark{[^}]\{0,200\}' ../../../styles/styles.css | head -2

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -o 'body\.g-root[^{]*{[^}]*}' styles/styles.css | head -3; grep -o '\.g-root{[^}]\{0,300\}' styles/styles.css | head -3; cat build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.js | head -60; ls ../icons | grep -iE '^(Moon|Sun|House|ListCheck|CircleInfo|Gear)\.'
grep -oE '\.g-root[^{,]*\{[^}]{0,250}' styles/styles.css | grep -v 'theme_' | head -5; grep -c 'g-root_theme_dark' styles/styles.css
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat tabs/hooks/useTab.js | head -50; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls Switch
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

mkdir -p .smoke && sed -e "s#/home/sandbox/workspace/src/#../src/#g" /tmp/smoke/smoke.test.tsx > .smoke/smoke.test.tsx && timeout 90 npx vitest run .smoke/smoke.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -15; rm -rf .smoke /tmp/smoke dist; git status --short
git status --short; git stash list; timeout 90 npx vitest run --config .smoke/vitest.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E 'AssertionError|Expected|Received|×|✓|FAIL|Error' | head -20
rm -rf .smoke && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && rm -rf dist && git status --short
